title: POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/imports request
description: Imports a reference file the researcher uploaded to private R2 via POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/import-uploads (contract addition 2026-11-23, see ../contract-additions.md and import-upload.response.json). The API parses it deterministically (T0 code, no LLM), normalises each entry, and files one search run with database import plus one record per entry. Formats: ris, bibtex, csv, csl-json (Zotero Better CSL JSON and Mendeley), endnote-xml, nbib (PubMed). Aliases json, csl, xml, endnote and medline are accepted by the server. Owner, editor or analyst only. New formats and the dedup rule are in docs/research/contracts/phase-5/polish-format-import.md.
